name: Humanities
scope: Trunk card. What people made, meant, and argued about. Nothing files directly here.

name: Philosophy
scope: Metaphysics, ethics, aesthetics, epistemology, and the philosophy of any X. Formal logic is 4010.

name: Religion and theology
scope: Comparative religion, mythology, scripture, doctrine, ritual, and every specific tradition. One card per tradition, then branch beneath it.

name: History
scope: Historiography, periods, regions, and historical biography. A discipline's own history files with that discipline, not here.

name: Language and linguistics
scope: Phonetics, grammar, semantics, etymology, translation, and individual languages. The study of language; writing it well is 1060.

name: Literature
scope: Poetry, prose, drama as text, criticism, genre, and national literatures. Reading it; writing it is 1060.

name: Writing and rhetoric
scope: Composition, style, argument, storytelling, editing. Craft rather than criticism. Writing that sells something is 5060.

name: Visual arts
scope: Painting, sculpture, photography, printmaking, craft, and art history.

name: Performing arts
scope: Music, theatre, dance, and film, including the technical craft of performance.

name: Social science
scope: Trunk card. How people behave together, studied as a system. Nothing files directly here.

name: Anthropology
scope: Cultural, physical, and linguistic anthropology; ethnography, folklore, kinship.

name: Archaeology
scope: Material remains, excavation, dating methods, and specific sites and cultures.

name: Sociology
scope: Social structure, class, demography, institutions, deviance, family, and social movements.

name: Psychology
scope: Cognitive, clinical, developmental, and social psychology. Attention, habit, motivation, and memory file here; their neural machinery is 3050.

name: Economics
scope: Micro, macro, trade, monetary theory, behavioural economics. Theory of the economy; running a business is 5060.

name: Political science
scope: Government, political theory, international relations, elections, power. Delivering policy is 5110.

name: Geography
scope: Human geography, cartography, regional studies, GIS, place and space. Rock and weather are 3040.

name: Communication and media
scope: Journalism, broadcasting, mass communication, platforms, media theory. Selling through them is 5060.

name: Area and ethnic studies
scope: Work scoped to a region or an identity rather than to a method. Use when the region is the subject, not the setting.

name: Futures and foresight
scope: Futurology, scenario planning, forecasting, long-range risk.

name: Natural science
scope: Trunk card. The physical world and its mechanisms. Nothing files directly here.

name: Physics
scope: Mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, quantum, relativity, particle physics.

name: Chemistry
scope: Organic, inorganic, analytical, and physical chemistry; matter at the molecular level.

name: Astronomy and space science
scope: Cosmology, astrophysics, planetary science, observation, and the science of spaceflight.

name: Earth science
scope: Geology, meteorology, oceanography, hydrology, palaeontology, and climate as a physical system.

name: Biology
scope: Genetics, cell and molecular biology, evolution, microbiology, botany, zoology, physiology, metabolism, neuroscience as mechanism.

name: Ecology and environment
scope: Ecosystems, biodiversity, population dynamics, climate impact. How nature works; managing it is 5090.

name: Formal science
scope: Trunk card. Abstract structure that is true regardless of the world. Nothing files directly here.

name: Logic
scope: Formal, mathematical, and philosophical logic; proof, validity, fallacy. Arguing persuasively is 1060.

name: Mathematics
scope: Algebra, geometry, analysis, number theory, topology, discrete mathematics.

name: Statistics and probability
scope: Distributions, inference, experimental design, sampling, and data analysis.

name: Computer science
scope: Algorithms, data structures, computability, complexity, programming language theory. Theory; building software is 4050.

name: Software engineering
scope: Design, architecture, testing, delivery, tooling, and team practice. The craft of shipping working systems.

name: Artificial intelligence
scope: Machine learning, neural networks, language models, robotics, alignment and safety.

name: Information and systems science
scope: Information theory, cybernetics, network theory, complexity, systems thinking. The theory of organising knowledge; the practice of keeping notes is 5030.

name: Applied science and practice
scope: Trunk card. Doing things in the world: professions, trades, and practices. Nothing files directly here.

name: Agriculture and food
scope: Agronomy, horticulture, animal husbandry, aquaculture, forestry practice, food science, cooking.

name: Architecture and design
scope: Built environment, urban planning, interiors, industrial and product design, typography, interface design.

name: Education and learning
scope: Pedagogy, curriculum, assessment, educational psychology, and self-directed study.

name: Note-taking and knowledge systems
scope: Zettelkasten, personal knowledge management, reading method, memory technique, indexing. Cards about running this box file here.

name: Engineering and technology
scope: Mechanical, electrical, civil, chemical, materials, and manufacturing engineering. Software engineering is 4050.

name: Medicine and health
scope: Anatomy, pathology, pharmacology, clinical practice, nursing, public health, mental health treatment.

name: Nutrition and metabolic health
scope: Diet, fasting, keto, macronutrients, and metabolic protocols as practice. How a metabolism works is 3050.

name: Business and management
scope: Strategy, operations, entrepreneurship, org design, people management, accounting, governance. Practice; economic theory is 2050.

name: Sales and negotiation
scope: Selling, commercial persuasion, deal-making, pricing, objection handling.

name: Marketing and branding
scope: Positioning, brand, advertising, copywriting, content, channels, consumer behaviour.

name: Finance and investing
scope: Corporate and personal finance, capital markets, venture capital, valuation, financial risk.

name: Law and jurisprudence
scope: Constitutional, criminal, civil, contract, intellectual property, and international law; legal theory and practice.

name: Military and security
scope: Strategy, tactics, defence technology, logistics, intelligence, information security.

name: Environment and sustainability
scope: Conservation, resource management, forestry policy, energy transition, climate policy. Managing nature; the science is 3060.

name: Library and information practice
scope: Cataloguing, classification, archives, curation, museum studies, records management.

name: Public administration and policy
scope: Governance, public management, service delivery, policy design and evaluation.

name: Social work and human services
scope: Casework, community services, welfare, counselling practice.

name: Sport and recreation
scope: Physical performance, training, coaching, kinesiology, leisure, games and play.

name: Transport and logistics
scope: Transport systems, supply chain, mobility, freight, infrastructure operations.

name: Home and personal management
scope: Household economics, personal organisation, productivity, focus, and time practice, consumer decisions. The psychology behind it is 2040.
